issues.description: Ingest writes valid records before enforcing the malformed-row threshold, so a nonzero ingest still mutates the database.
GPU TRES parsing matches any key starting with gres/gpu, crashing on gres/gpumem and double-counting generic plus typed GPU entries.
Failure reporting looks for OOM but misses Slurm's OUT_OF_MEMORY state.
Timestamp parsing accepts timezone-aware ISO values but stores the original string without normalizing to a comparable canonical time.
Date filtering and trailing-window queries compare timestamp strings lexicographically, which gives incorrect results for mixed timezone offsets.
CLI only handles parse/date validation errors and will show raw tracebacks for file read, encoding, and SQLite failures.
Database initialization has no schema versioning or migration path, making future active development risky once user databases exist.
Malformed-threshold test asserts the exit code but not that the failed ingest left the database unchanged.
